projects.title: E-commerce recommendation system
projects.description: Developed an intelligent e-commerce recommendation system using Flask and machine learning techniques. Implemented content-based, collaborative filtering, and hybrid models to provide personalized product suggestions. Integrated the system into a Flask-based web application featuring user authentication, product browsing, and dynamic recommendations. Leveraged libraries like NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow for data processing and model training. This project enhances user engagement, improves customer satisfaction, and delivers a seamless shopping experience.

projects.title: AI Based Exam Evaluation System
projects.description:
AI-Based Exam Evaluation System is an intelligent web application designed to automate and enhance the traditional exam evaluation process using Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques.

The system evaluates subjective/descriptive answers by analyzing semantic similarity, keyword relevance, and conceptual correctness between student responses and model answers. This reduces human bias, saves time, and ensures fair and consistent assessment.

The platform supports real-time evaluation, instant scoring, and structured feedback, making it suitable for educational institutions, online examinations, and skill assessment platforms.
